source_changes: Preserved partial-write candidate only; production sources unchanged

native_diagnostic.purpose: SQL step and WAL bytes only; excluded from throughput

fuse.first_workload: 256MiB into a new or independently aged workspace

adoption_gate.correctness: all related tests and all content/schema checks pass
adoption_gate.software: unaligned native CPU median >=5% lower with improvement in >=6 of 8 pairs per shift; aligned <=5% regression
adoption_gate.plain_fuse: per medium and state, workload median and aggregate throughput no more than 5% lower; request p99 no more than 20% higher (ignore sub-1ms absolute increase); total lifecycle no more than 5% longer
adoption_gate.insufficient_evidence: If barriers remain unstable or tests fail gates, preserve candidate without enabling; do not retune or discard slow samples; independent physical storage needed if software win alone is established
